title: Playwright team config
description: Schema for playwright.yaml in a repository's convention home (default docs/conventions): the team layer of the playwright plugin's settings. Keys are read by /playwright:demo-video and the install-python-deps SessionStart hook, and listed in plugins/playwright/README.md, Configuration. Contract: docs/adr/0064-home-plugin-customization-in-docs-conventions-yaml.md.

install_python_deps_enabled.description: Whether the SessionStart install-python-deps hook installs demo-video Python packages (numpy, Pillow) into the plugin data directory. A user-layer value in pluginConfigs wins when set; otherwise this repository value overrides the plugin default (false).

verification.description: How much independent checking this plugin's skills run: off, light (the default: skip the verifier dispatch), standard (run it) or strict (also run the optional passes). Read from the default branch's committed copy only, so a branch cannot lower it. Levels: docs/contracts/verification-level/README.md.

verification_skills.description: Per-skill verification level, keyed by skill name (for example demo-video); an entry beats this file's verification value.
